name: Duskling
traits: Medium Fey with the Incarnum subtype. +2 Constitution, −2 Intelligence. Base land speed 30 ft. Low-light vision doubles human range with color and detail.

Effects that specifically target humanoids, such as charm person, cannot target a Duskling. The species chooses a fixed home plane at character creation with DM approval. On the Material Plane it has the Extraplanar subtype.
The Incarnum subtype marks eligibility for targeted effects. The permanent racial essentia pool increases by 1, or starts at 1 if the character has no other source.
Racial movement gives a +5-ft. enhancement bonus to land speed per invested essentia. It applies with light or no armor and a light load.
Reallocate essentia among the eligible investments as a swift action on your turn. Pool size and the capacity of each investment are separate.
Normal capacity per investment is 1 at character levels 1–5, 2 at 6–11, 3 at 12–17, and 4 at 18–20.

Common and Sylvan are automatic. Bonus languages are Elf (the book’s name for Elven), Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, and Halfling. Favored class Totemist. The published examples list LA +0 and use class Hit Dice.

The optional 1st-level Duskling Barbarian substitution uses a d10 Hit Die. Incarnum Speed replaces Fast Movement. Each invested point gives +10 ft. enhancement to base land speed with up to medium armor and load and +2 insight on initiative checks. The two enhancement bonuses to speed do not stack.

The optional d10 Barbarian substitutions at 7th and 11th level grant Incarnum Defense and Incarnum Rage respectively. Defense replaces Barbarian damage reduction and gives DR 1/— plus resistance 1 to each energy type per point. Incarnum Rage replaces Greater Rage and grants 2 essentia during rage. Greater Rage then replaces Mighty Rage if reached.
